statements.statement: CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring was ordered
Patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
Patient has personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
The study was indicated to evaluate for arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events (G45.9)
The study was indicated to guide anticoagulation management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The monitoring service is a distinct, medically necessary diagnostic evaluation
